name: Economy log: the daily cleanup deletes rows older than CoA.EconomyLog.KeepDays and keeps the rest
contract: With CoA.EconomyLog.KeepDays = 90 (the default), the economy log's daily cleanup deletes every coa_economy_log row whose time is more than 90 days before the cleanup and keeps every newer row.
A level-60 Human destroys Grand Marshal's Longsword (12584, epic), which writes one item_destroy row; a cleanup now and one 89 days later keep it, one 91 days later deletes it.
The background cleanup the worldserver runs at startup and once a day deletes the same rows: a second sword's item_destroy row is gone after a background cleanup 91 days later.

A KeepDays change (a config reload) drops a background cleanup in progress and starts it again with the new value. A third sword's row would be deleted by a background cleanup 91 days later, but KeepDays becomes 180 before its first batch: the row is kept. A background cleanup 181 days later under 180 would delete it, but KeepDays becomes 0 before its first batch: nothing is deleted. Back at 90, a background cleanup 91 days later deletes it.

The KeepDays change follows the cleanup start in the next step: the harness runs one step per world update, and the background cleanup sends its first delete no earlier than the update after its first probe.

steps.label: Destroy Grand Marshal's Longsword
THE LOG: the sword's item_destroy row
Cleanup today
THE LOG: a new row is kept
Cleanup 89 days later
THE LOG: an 89-day-old row is kept
Cleanup 91 days later
THE LOG: a 91-day-old row is deleted
Destroy a second Grand Marshal's Longsword
THE LOG: the second sword's item_destroy row
Background cleanup 91 days later
THE LOG: deleted by the background cleanup
Destroy a third Grand Marshal's Longsword
THE LOG: the third sword's item_destroy row
Background cleanup 91 days later (KeepDays 90 would delete the row)
KeepDays becomes 180 before the first batch
As long as the control below may take to delete
THE LOG: the cleanup uses the new KeepDays and keeps the row
Background cleanup 181 days later (KeepDays 180 would delete the row)
KeepDays becomes 0 (keep everything) before the first batch
As long as the control below may take to delete
THE LOG: KeepDays 0 stops the cleanup in progress
KeepDays back to 90
Background cleanup 91 days later
CONTROL: at 90 days the background cleanup deletes the row
